object.description: Give a document a figure, a view and a filter. For each kind of edit (create, edit and delete an object, add a link, set and clear a figure, rename a view, save a filter, change the document's title), make the folder it writes in a link to a copy elsewhere: once after Mellon has read the document, and from the start for the edits that don't read it. Then make an object file a symbolic link to a file elsewhere after the read, and edit and delete that object. Last, reach the repository root itself through a link and edit through it. Expected: each edit through a link is refused, naming the link, and nothing behind the link changes; the linked object file stays a link; the edits through the root's link are made.
